subject: Risk & Compliance
title: ESG and Governance
description: A 60-second lesson on ESG and Governance.

hook.text: Investors now evaluate companies on environmental, social, and governance factors — not just profits.

buildup.text: ESG governance includes board diversity, executive pay alignment, anti-corruption policies, and risk oversight.

discovery.text: BlackRock, the world's largest asset manager, votes against directors who fail on ESG governance standards.

twist.text: Anti-ESG backlash calls it political. Supporters say it's just good risk management with a new label.

climax.text: Whether you call it ESG or risk management, governance is expanding beyond financials to broader impact.

punchline.text: ESG or risk management? Same idea. Different politics.

quiz.question: What does the 'G' in ESG stand for?
